instruction: How many songs from across my spotify song and album libraries were released in this year?
notes: Fixed the name clash: the `supervisor` app constant (unused in any precondition/effect) was removed and the person predicate renamed to `is-supervisor`, so no name is defined twice. Read-only question task: no database changes are required, so the goal only demands that the needed information has been gathered and the task is completed with the count as the answer. `library-song` is a representative object standing for every song in the song library; at runtime spotify.show_song is repeated for each song_id returned by the (paginated) show_song_library. Album release dates and song_ids come directly from show_album_library, so no per-album call is modeled. The current-year threshold comes from phone.get_current_date_and_time (no login needed). The answer count object is tied to supervisor-complete-task via the static (answer-count ?c) fact and is computed at runtime as the number of unique song ids released this year across both libraries. supervisor-complete-task is the only action without (not (task-completed)) as a blocker for others; every other action requires (not (task-completed)), and (task-completed) is produced only by supervisor-complete-task, so it is necessarily the final plan step.
